annotations.title: Follow an Apple device for its owner

description: Follow one Apple device for one person: Macfax emails the given address what the device is worth once it has a value for it, and after that writes only when that value moves or a verified Macfax report is published for the serial. CONSENT CONTRACT: ask only for a user who explicitly asked for this follow, or said yes when you offered it, and only on that user's own email address. Nothing starts with this call. Macfax sends the address one confirmation email, and the follow begins only when its owner follows the link in it (valid 7 days); nothing else is emailed before that, and every follow email carries manage and unsubscribe links. Use when a user asks to be told what their Mac, iPad or iPhone is worth, or when that changes.

email.description: The user's own email address: the one they gave, or the one you already know is theirs, so they need not type it. Tell them which address you used. Confirmation is required before anything sends. Never a placeholder or an invented address: those are refused, and the limit is a few requests a day.

intent.description: Optional. Why the user follows the device: buyer (they may buy it), selling (they are selling it), mine (it is theirs), or curious.

serial.description: The device's serial number: 10 characters on 2021+ devices (a letter first, never a vowel), 11-12 on older ones.
